name: Dongguan Development (Holdings) Co., Ltd.
summary: Dongguan Development (Holdings) Co., Ltd. develops, invests, constructs, and operates urban rail transit in China. The company operates in three segments: Highway Toll Collection and Overseas Investment, Financial Services, and New Energy Vehicle Charging. It also provides financial leasing and commercial factoring, as well as new energy vehicle charging and swapping. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Fudi Technology Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
